scope: Exploratory feasibility contract; freeze production task settings before Phase 4 dataset collection.

world.python_axes: X/Y ground plane, Z up; positive heading turns +X toward +Y

actions.gripper: above +0.5 requests pickup; below -0.5 requests release; otherwise hold
actions.movement: Ideal differential-drive velocity targets implemented through planar MuJoCo servo joints; no wheel rolling/slip model.

observations.target: capsule while empty; tray while carrying
observations.phase: holding flag supplies phase; one shared goal-conditioned policy
observations.sensing: Oracle relative target positions and exact body velocities; no camera inference, range sensor or noise in Phase 0.

grasp.semantics: Explicit constrained attachment; no learned finger contacts or force feedback.
grasp.pickup: Gripper tip within 0.10 m of capsule XY and abs(normalized commanded forward velocity) < 0.25.
grasp.carry: Capsule position follows gripper tip at Z=0.28 m, free-joint velocity cleared each substep.
grasp.release: Capsule lowered to Z=0.05 m at tip; success requires tip within tray radius and low commanded forward speed.
grasp.limits: Pickup/release use commanded speed, not measured speed; actual-speed and height gates are required in Phase 2. Capsule/chassis contact is disabled; force transfer, drops and tray walls are not modeled.

termination.success: Valid release within tray acceptance radius

dataset.training_sources: 100 scripted expert rollouts plus 12000 synthetic teacher-labeled local observation states, with 30 additional copies of grasp/release examples.
dataset.synthetic_limits: Synthetic observation coverage can include unreachable poses; it augments imitation labels, not successful physical rollouts. No human demonstrations in Phase 0.
dataset.checkpoint_selection: Validation successes first, then shorter mean episode duration; final test seeds never used in Phase 0.

next_phase_gates.note: Proposed gates for subsequent implementation, recorded after exploratory Phase 0; not preregistered Phase 0 results.
next_phase_gates.reference: 100% completion on the declared validation suite with no collisions
next_phase_gates.imitation: At least 80% complete episodes on validation, reported beside collisions and invalid actions
next_phase_gates.final_release: Freeze thresholds and test protocol before final test evaluation; no guarantee from the 30-scenario Phase 0 result

curriculum: one capsule, ideal target positions, clear travel area
larger starting position and heading variation
small reachable obstacle layouts with range observations
multiple capsules composed as single-object skills
sensor noise and image-derived perception as later extensions
